class: Two work items built in parallel branches each pass CI on their own base, but one adds a repo-wide guard (an import scan, an inventory, an allowlist) that the other's new code violates; the clash shows only when the branches meet, so a branch merged first can turn the other red after it was verified.
mechanism: W-059 (merged) added a test that no file outside the Kite market-data adapter imports Kite modules; W-058 (open, verified at an older base) adds Kite login adapter modules. Each branch was green alone; the combined W-061 branch (W-058 + main) went red.
fix: Before merging any branch, merge the current origin/main into it and re-run CI (merge_when_green refuses a stale base only when GitHub marks it conflicting, not when a guard changed). W-058 was merged with main and its adapter files named in the guard's allowlist with a REQ-063 AC-1 reason.

detection.note: Mechanism planned (learning L2, second occurrence): issue #154 - require every PR to be tested on the current main before merge (GitHub 'require branches to be up to date', an owner setting); until then the orchestrator merges main into a branch and re-runs both suites before opening or merging its PR.

occurrences.evidence: W-024 merged with main: 2 app tests failed (route without ApiModel; error body outside the boundary) and 1 producer-inventory test failed, all on W-063's outcome route; each branch was green alone
